issues.title: Twin smoke — low-priority contract ticket
issues.description:
## Goal
Smoke fixture ticket (none priority) for the SF-009 Linear twin.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] pulled by linear-puller via the twin

## Scope
Fixture-only; never reaches a real board.

issues.title: Twin smoke — urgent contract ticket
issues.description:
## Goal
Smoke fixture ticket (urgent priority) — must sort FIRST under SF-007 expedite ordering.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] sorts ahead of ZOU-9001

## Scope
Fixture-only; never reaches a real board.

issues.title: Twin smoke — unlabeled ticket, must be filtered out
issues.description:
## Goal
Carries no factory-ready label — the twin's filter must exclude it.

issues.title: Twin smoke — In-Review ticket, must be reaped + excluded
issues.description:
## Goal
Urgent-priority ticket that has left the backlog (In Review / started). The puller must strip its factory-ready label (reap) and never select it, even though it outranks ZOU-9002 on priority.
